title: 第0022章 绝脉初愈药徒三重第0023章 仙茅破障夜袭林府血染青石阶
content_zh:
第0022章绝脉初愈，药徒三重
------
晨光透过破旧的木窗洒进屋内，林药尘盘膝坐在石床上，双眼微闭，呼吸绵长。
体内，一股温润而坚韧的药力正缓缓游走，像是春日解冻的溪流，一点点冲刷着干涸已久的经脉。
这是仙鹤草的药力。
自从觉醒万古药尊系统，这株看似普通的凡级草药，便成了他逆天改命的第一块基石。
“仙鹤草，固元止血，修复残脉。”
系统的提示音在脑海中回响，林药尘能清晰地感受到，原本寸断的绝脉，正被这股药力一点点缝合、滋养。虽然距离完全修复还差得远，但至少，他已经能隐约感应到天地间稀薄的灵气了。
“药徒三重……”
他缓缓睁开眼，眸中闪过一丝精芒。
从废柴到药徒三重，只用了短短二十余日。若非亲身经历，他绝不敢相信这是真的。
------
“吱呀——”
房门被轻轻推开，表妹林婉儿端着一碗热气腾腾的药汤走了进来。
“药尘哥，你醒了。”她轻声说道，将药碗放在床边的小几上，“这是家里仅剩的一点凝血草熬的，虽不如仙鹤草，但也能帮你调理气血。”
林药尘看了她一眼，心中微暖。
林婉儿是林家旁系中唯一对他真心相待的人。在他被视为废柴、人人避之不及的那些年里，只有她还会偷偷送来一点吃食、几株普通草药。
“谢谢。”他接过药碗，一饮而尽。
药汤苦涩，却带着一丝暖意，顺着喉咙流入胃中，化作一股微弱的热流，与体内的仙鹤草药力交融。
“药尘哥，你……真的能修炼了吗？”林婉儿压低声音，眼中满是期待与担忧，“昨日我听说，林啸天已经从青炎城回来了，还带回了一位药师。家族里都在传，他要当众废掉你的另一条腿，以儆效尤。”

林药尘放下药碗，嘴角勾起一抹冷意。
“他敢来，我就让他爬着回去。”
------
正午时分，林家演武场。
烈日当空，地面被晒得滚烫。
数十名林家子弟聚集在场边，窃窃私语，目光时不时瞟向场中央那个瘦削的身影。
林药尘独自站在演武场上，身形单薄，却脊背挺得笔直。
对面，林啸天一身锦袍，腰佩长剑，脸上挂着毫不掩饰的倨傲。他身旁站着一位灰袍老者，正是他从青炎城请回来的药师——杜药师。
“林药尘。”林啸天冷笑，“你这废柴，竟还敢出现在演武场？今日，我便当着全族的面，断了你的狗腿，看你还能不能翻身！”
话音未落，他脚下一蹬，身形如电，长剑出鞘，寒光直取林药尘左膝！
围观的林家子弟纷纷惊呼。
这一剑若是落实，林药尘的左腿恐怕就要彻底废了。
然而，就在剑锋即将触及肌肤的刹那，林药尘动了。
他侧身一闪，动作虽不算快，却精准地避开了致命一击。与此同时，右拳挥出，拳风中带着一丝若有若无的药力波动。
“砰！”
拳头砸在林啸天胸口，力道不大，却震得他连退三步，脸色一白。
全场哗然。
“他……他怎么能躲开？”
“那一拳，难道是他练了武？”
林啸天稳住身形，眼中闪过一丝惊疑，随即化为暴怒：“好啊，原来你一直在装废柴！杜药师，请您出手，废了他！”

杜药师眯了眯眼，缓步上前。
身为青炎城小有名气的药师，他自然能看出林药尘身上那股微弱的药力波动。
content_en:
Chapter 0022: The first recovery from the severed pulse, the third level of medicine disciple
------
The morning light poured into the house through the dilapidated wooden windows. Lin Yaochen sat cross-legged on the stone bed, his eyes slightly closed and his breathing long.
Within the body, a warm and tough medicinal power was slowly flowing, like a thawing stream in spring, washing away the long-dried meridians bit by bit.
This is the medicinal power of agrimony.
Since awakening the Eternal Medicine Master System, this seemingly ordinary mortal herb has become the first cornerstone for him to change his life against the heavens.
"Agrimony, it can strengthen Yuan, stop bleeding, and repair residual veins."
The system's beep echoed in his mind, and Lin Yaochen could clearly feel that the originally severed pulse was being stitched together and nourished bit by bit by this medicinal power. Although he was still far from being completely repaired, at least he could vaguely sense the thin spiritual energy between heaven and earth.
"The Third Level of Medicine Disciple..."
He slowly opened his eyes, a glimmer of light flashing in his eyes.
It only took more than twenty days to go from useless to third level medicine disciple. If he hadn't experienced it himself, he would never have believed it was true.
------
"Squeak——"
The door was gently pushed open, and cousin Lin Wan'er walked in carrying a bowl of steaming medicinal soup.
"Brother Yaochen, you're awake." She said softly, placing the medicine bowl on the small table beside the bed. "This is made from the only blood coagulation grass left at home. Although it is not as good as agrimony, it can also help you regulate your qi and blood."
Lin Yaochen glanced at her, feeling warm in his heart.
Lin Wan'er was the only person in the Lin family who treated him sincerely. In those years when he was regarded as useless and shunned by everyone, she was the only one who would secretly send him some food and a few common herbs.
"Thank you." He took the medicine bowl and drank it in one gulp.
The medicinal soup is bitter, but with a hint of warmth, flowing down the throat into the stomach, turning into a weak heat flow, blending with the power of the crane herb in the body.
"Brother Yaochen, can you...really be able to practice?" Lin Wan'er lowered her voice, her eyes full of expectation and worry, "Yesterday I heard that Lin Xiaotian had returned from Qingyan City and brought back a pharmacist. There is a rumor in the family that he will destroy your other leg in public as a warning to others."
Lin Yaochen put down the medicine bowl with a cold look on his lips.
"If he dares to come, I will let him crawl back."
------
At noon, the Lin family performs martial arts.
The sun was blazing in the sky, and the ground was scalding hot.
Dozens of Lin family members gathered on the sidelines, whispering, and occasionally glancing at the thin figure in the center of the field.
Lin Yaochen stood alone on the martial arts field. He was thin but his back was straight.
Opposite him, Lin Xiaotian was dressed in a brocade robe, with a long sword on his waist, and an undisguised arrogance on his face. Standing next to him was an old man in gray robe, who was the pharmacist he invited back from Qingyan City - Pharmacist Du.
"Lin Yaochen." Lin Xiaotian sneered, "You loser, how dare you show up at the martial arts arena? Today, in front of the entire clan, I will break your legs to see if you can stand up!"
Before he finished speaking, he kicked his feet, his body was like lightning, the long sword was unsheathed, and the cold light hit Lin Yaochen's left knee!
The Lin family disciples who were watching all exclaimed.
If this sword was carried out, Lin Yaochen's left leg would probably be completely disabled.
However, just when the sword edge was about to touch his skin, Lin Yaochen moved.
He dodged sideways, and although his movements were not very fast, he accurately avoided the fatal blow. At the same time, his right fist was swung out, with a hint of medicinal power in the fist wind.
"Bang!"
The fist hit Lin Xiaotian's chest. The force was not strong, but it shocked him to take three steps back and turned pale.
The whole place was in an uproar.
"He...how could he avoid it?"
"That punch, was he practicing martial arts?"
Lin Xiaotian steadied his body, a trace of surprise flashed in his eyes, and then turned into rage: "Okay, it turns out you have been pretending to be a loser! Du Yaoshi, please take action and kill him!"
Pharmacist Du narrowed his eyes and stepped forward slowly.
As a well-known pharmacist in Qingyan City, he naturallyIt was possible to see the weak fluctuation of medicinal power on Lin Yaochen's body.
